verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a commerce SaaS like Shopify POS, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no recurring-schedule capability. The only automation mentioned is a threshold-triggered low-stock notification powered by Shopify Flow, a separate platform tool, and one-off Sidekick-created stock transfers. Neither is a user-defined recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
